'''Datto Wys''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] with a droid shop living in the city of [[Mos Ila]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Around [[3643 BBY]] he unwittingly served as a go-between contact between [[Mia Hawkins]] and [[Cipher Nine]].
